explanation.summary: SPØDARBAKKEN BARNEHAGE SA (987 002 662), a cooperative, is an active entity in Enhetsregisteret; founded 2004-05-25; address Linevegen 1, 4340 BRYNE, Norge. Main industry is 85.100 Førskoleundervisning og drift av barnehager; 27 registered employees; 1 registered sub-unit(s). Daily manager: Julie Elisabeth Øvestad; Board chair: Tore Jørgensen; Auditor: ERGA REVISJON AS. Accounts for 2025 (period ending 2025-12-31): revenue NOK 18.25 m, operating profit NOK -567.89 k, net profit NOK -573.07 k, equity NOK 2.14 m, total assets NOK 8.89 m. Website https://spodarbakken.no shows the registered name.
